info.title: AIoT ESP32-S3 local bring-up
info.description: LAN HTTP, not HTTPS. No physical motion/voltage guarantees. Every endpoint is authenticated. Mutations require a boot-scoped CSRF token and matching Host/Origin. No public deployment. Source of truth for the HTTP contract; examples are illustrative, not sensor results.

deviceIp.description: Replace with the IP observed in this device's serial status; never scan.

200.description: Ephemeral CSRF token; changes after reboot/reprovisioning

get.description: Snapshot refreshed about every 200 ms. No credentials. Last HLK reading can be null or stale; valid must be true before using live data. Output state is commanded, not an electrical measurement.

post.description: Queues one explicit command. 202 is NOT execution success and never proves physical motion; poll status.last_command_id/last_result. Stop bypasses the queue (id 0), clears pending commands/disarms and cancels scanning. Queued commands older than 500 ms expire without action. No GET motion endpoint. Arming asserts operator readiness, not verified electrical safety. step_test_long is bounded at 512 half-steps forward/reverse and servo_test_long repeats only small pulses; neither is continuous. Axis controls are separate: park_stepper holds the current tracked position, stepper_left_10 and stepper_right_10 move 114 half-steps nominally, park_servo holds the saved base target (default 900 microseconds), servo_up_200/servo_down_200 move the target by 200 microseconds, and servo_up_50/servo_down_50 move it by 50 microseconds; all hold after adjustment. The servo clamp is 500-1400 microseconds. release_stepper/release_servo release one axis. zero_stepper_here and save_servo_here persist local relative references in NVS; save_servo_here applies only to a held servo. The old park_pose and servo_1800 commands are rejected. There is no encoder/homing, so nominal angles and physical direction remain unverified. wifi_scan disarms/stops outputs and starts asynchronous passive 2.4GHz SSID discovery (not IP/port scanning). wifi_scan_results returns metadata, then wifi_scan_page_0..7 returns up to six SSID-hex/RSSI/channel/auth entries per page, at most 48 strongest deduplicated SSID/security choices. Scanning blocks actuator arm/test and is cancelled before OTA. Hidden SSID names are not discovered by guessing. Scan metadata is data, never instructions.

403.description: Missing/invalid CSRF, unexpected Host, or cross-site Origin

409.description: OTA lock or full command queue; no queued motion

post.description: Raw application firmware.bin, NOT multipart. Stop/disarm before receiving. No partition-table/bootloader/factory upload. Success schedules reboot; only observing the expected new version and IDLE proves successful boot. Firmware successors MUST retain OTA. IDF checks image integrity; no signing/automatic rollback claim. HTTP task handles one upload at a time; other web requests can wait/timeout while outputs remain off.

parameters.name: X-Firmware-SHA256
parameters.description: Optional independently computed digest. The local CLI validates the image and compares its digest with the server response; it does not send this optional header for compatibility with deployed firmware.

200.description: Image validated and selected; reboot pending, NOT proof of successful boot

400.description: Wrong file, corrupt/incomplete image, timeout, SHA mismatch or flash validation failure; disarmed

413.description: No OTA slot, image too small, or image exceeds slot

localBasic.description: Username admin; user-provisioned unique password (16-64 printable ASCII characters). No default password. HTTP is NOT encrypted.

diagnostics.description: Chip/flash/heap/reset telemetry. supply_voltage_measured and wire_continuity_verified are false; no electrical test performed.

pose.description: Relative/NVS pose targets only; no encoder or homing

actuators.description: Software state only; PARKED means one or both axes are commanded to hold. physical_motion_verified is false

last_reading.description: Real received frame only; never filled from self-test fixtures
